product.title: Private Yellowstone Wildlife Sightseeing Tour

description.text: A full-day private wildlife sightseeing route covers Lamar Valley, Hayden Valley, and Mammoth Hot Springs with flexible pickup from West Yellowstone or park gates. The guide focuses on bear, wolf, and bison behavior with interpretive commentary and spotting scopes at each wildlife corridor.

highlights: Lamar Valley and Hayden Valley predator corridors
Mammoth Hot Springs terrace visit included
Spotting scopes and binoculars on every stop
Flexible pickup from West Yellowstone area

start.description: Pickup from West Yellowstone hotels or coordinated park gate meeting point. Early starts recommended for Lamar Valley wildlife.

end.description: Return to your pickup location after the final Hayden Valley or canyon wildlife stop.

product.itinerarySummary: A full-day private wildlife sightseeing route covers Lamar Valley, Hayden Valley, and Mammoth Hot Springs with flexible pickup from West Yellowstone or park gates.

itineraryItems.title: Lamar Valley
itineraryItems.description: Morning wildlife drive through Lamar Valley scanning for wolves and grizzly bears.

itineraryItems.title: Hayden Valley
itineraryItems.description: Midday and afternoon bison herds and raptor viewing in Hayden Valley.

itineraryItems.title: Mammoth Hot Springs
itineraryItems.description: Walk the Mammoth Hot Springs travertine terraces and elk lawn area.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone
itineraryItems.description: Optional rim stop at the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone when time allows.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Private Yellowstone Wildlife Sightseeing Tour?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 7 to 9 hours.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from in Yellowstone National Park?
faqs.answer: Pickup from West Yellowstone hotels or coordinated park gate meeting point. Early starts recommended for Lamar Valley wildlife.
